'''Yun Baliss''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duke/Legends|duke]] who was a member of [[House Baliss]], a minor family on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that remained neutral when [[Alderaan Civil War|war]] broke out between the major houses, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When the [[House Baliss (estate)|Baliss estate]] was overrun by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], Yun decided to capitalize on the chaos engulfing Alderaan and make the Teraan estate the new Baliss home.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Baliss (Smuggler)}}</ref>

After the smuggler known as [[Voidhound|Ace]] stole a datapad from the Baliss estate to allow [[House Teraan]] to regain their lost fortune, the Duke sent his son [[Xin Baliss]] to exact vengeance against House Teraan by challenging [[Lenn Teraan]] to a blaster duel to the death. As Lenn had never mastered the blaster, he and his sister [[Cedonia Teraan|Cedonia]] persuaded Ace to stand as their champion, who defeated Xin in the duel.<ref name="Duel" />
